Coweta County, Georgia replaced its 180-day pause with a permanent data center ordinance within the original window. appropriate frame is not whether moratoria are categorically desirable or harmful. It is whether they  are well-designed and well-executed
. A moratorium with detailed findings, a functional definition, the “earlier of” sunset pattern,
a phased study plan, and exemptions for vested rights can serve the public interest while minimizing legal exposure and economic disruption.
A moratorium adopted reflexively, drafted without definitions, extended repeatedly, and allowed to expire without replacement regulation wastes the time it was meant to buy.
